item.title: Palmyra ~Nessa no Umi to Binaru Senki~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ohgetsu
  • 発売日: 2008-06-06
  • スコア: なし (2 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Palmyra～熱砂の海と美なる戦姫～
  • 英語名: Palmyra Nessa no Umi to Binaru Senki

别名

  • Palmyra The sea of heated sand and the beautiful war princess

あらすじ

The main character suddenly warped to a battlefield in the ancient Arabian country of Palmyra. Will he be able to survive the war taking place against his will and return to his home one day?

Palmyra is located between two big countries. When Princess Waba is on her way to one of the countries as a delegate, she sneaks out of the delegation. She enjoys freedom for a while, but she is captured by slave traders. What will happen to her…?

item.title: Silvery White ~Kimi to Deatta Wake~
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Ohgetsu
  • 発売日: 2006-09-29
  • スコア: 6.840000000000001/10 (16 人評価)
  • 日本語名: Silvery White ～君と出逢った理由～
  • 英語名: Silvery White Kimi to Deatta Wake

あらすじ

Shinya always has a trouble with others due to his special ability. One day, he receives a letter from his former teacher. He offers Shinya to move to a high school on a small island and Shinya accepts his offer. His letter says that there are some girls who have a special ability like his and he will be able to become friends with them. He spends a peaceful life in a new environment but he is getting involved in a mysterious phenomenon… and the curtain of this story rises slowly….

item.description:

  • 英語名: Oose no Mama ni ★ Goshujin-sama!

别名

  • As You Wish

あらすじ

Ousuke is a rich businessman living in a luxury hotel suite. At a fancy party, another wealthy man brags to him about his many maids. He says, “A man who can’t deal with maids cannot call himself a high-class man.” So Ousuke decides to buy a house and recruit some maids…
